CustomField.description: Deal Type for Sizing the Opportunity request
CustomField.inlineHelpText: PRICING DEAL: Attorney agrees to a specific increase in business sent to Oasis, tied to a change in our pricing for their clients AGREEMENT: Attorney agrees to a specific increase in business sent to Oasis, but with no pricing change NOTHING: There is not an agreement to change pricing, or a commitment from the firm to increase business PRICING PITCH: We believe that pricing will help gain us more business, but we don't have a specific number agreement
CustomField.label: Deal Type
